does: The engine application object's base constructor, run when App is built at the process's start. Script Extender calls this symbol App__Ctor and runs its PostStartup (Lua libraries, its engine hooks, the hook on ls::FileReader's constructor) in a pre-hook here.

evidence.says: Script Extender's mapping App::Instance calls the target after storing the new App in BaseApp::s_AppInstance; the decompiler and symbol databases name code:App::Ctor BaseApp::BaseApp
GameEngine.dll exports this name; the symbol database matches the export to this function by strings
